items.markdown: **Figure 35.** Plots of the energy ratio $E_r$ of fixed-wing over quadcopter energy as a function of straightaway distance and radius of curvature. Plots (a)–(d) represent different energy ratios across pairs of vehicles with the same mass (see Table 1). The domain of plots is determined by the “maximum” turning radius ($R_{\text{max}}$) computed using the cruise trim condition. The maximum of the $y$ domain corresponds to the maximum turning radius, while the maximum $x$ domain is bounded by $10\frac{\pi}{2}R_{\text{max}}$.
